components.name: HRRR cascade
components.what: L1 raw HRRR, L2 station bias, L3 decay, L4 diurnal, specialists.

components.name: NBM cascade
components.what: raw NBM, L2_nbm, L3_nbm, L4_nbm, wdp_nbm; runs beside the HRRR cascade.

components.name: Terminal blend
components.what: HRRR / NBM / ECMWF weights per field and lead band (t, h, ws 3-way), refit daily at 04:30 by the refitter. Fit truth: shrunk observed (station bias toward the model).

components.name: Selector
components.what: Picks HRRR side, NBM side or blend per field x regime x lead band and writes it into the served arrays.

components.name: t_urmab (URMA-truth blend)
components.what: Per-source bias vs URMA removed, then HRRR/NBM/ECMWF blended, 6 to 47 h. Logged as forecast_urmab; never served. Refit table registered with the refitter.

components.name: Scoreboard truth
components.what: Tiles grade on the pair-log observed: the station network shrunk toward the model, which is L2's own output. The truth table grades the same rows on station readings and (t) on URMA.

components.name: Weather Underground
components.what: Key throttled since October; Tempest is the only station feed.

components.name: WU archive poller
components.what: Dormant until a working key exists.

changes.title: debug page shows the architecture and a third truth
changes.change: the debug page opens with "Architecture now": each pipeline piece marked served, shadow or off, read from the code flags at build time, plus every release tagged as an architecture change. URMA joins the truth table for t.

changes.title: URMA-truth shadow blend for temperature
changes.change: Third truth, URMA (NOAA analysis), enters: t_urmab shadow blend logged every tick and refit daily by the refitter; nothing served changes.

changes.title: the same forecast scored on both truths
changes.change: Scoring on two truths side by side (truth_compare.json, hourly by the publisher).

changes.title: Tempest is now the only station feed, so it gets a health check
changes.change: Tempest becomes the only station feed (Weather Underground dead since 10-21).

changes.title: logging the station-only temperature and humidity next to the scored ones
changes.change: Second truth logged: observed_stations (station readings only) next to the model-shrunk observed for t, h, dp.

changes.title: blend weights now fit to the ECMWF timing the app receives
changes.change: Blend fit aligned to the ECMWF hour the app actually receives (1 h live lag).

changes.title: ECMWF joins the wind speed blend
changes.change: ECMWF added to the ws blend.

changes.title: ECMWF joins the temperature and humidity blend
changes.change: ECMWF IFS added as a third blend input for t and h (HRRR / NBM / ECMWF).

changes.title: t, h, sr, wg served as a blend of both forecasts
changes.change: t, h, sr and wg served as a blend of both forecasts.

changes.title: selector: blend instead of pick
changes.change: Selector serves a blend of the HRRR and NBM sides instead of picking one.

changes.title: refitter: every self-refitting live table moves to the cloud; churning cell sets become ship decisions
changes.change: Cloud refitter owns every self-refitting live table (daily 04:30 refit, no deploy needed).

changes.title: Router-as-authority — ch via ims-threshold, sr via GBM, both live
changes.change: Router-as-authority: ch routed by an ims threshold and sr by a GBM, both live (2 fields).
